title: ר' יוחנן בן דהבאי
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan ben Dehavai said: ‘The ministering angels told me four things: why are people lame?’ and so forth: Nedarim, chapter 2, 20a. He is also named in Sifra, Metzora. In Rabbi Yehudah’s name: Arakhin 2b, Sanhedrin 4, Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat 19:3, and Chagigah 2a and 4b. In Rabbi Yehudah ben Tema’s name: Sanhedrin 4b. ‘Rabbi Chanina ben Gamliel’s words; Rabbi Yochanan ben Dehavai says’: Menachot 42b. Nachalat Shimoni [digital witness: הצחלת; title restored provisionally] forgot to mention him.
